summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests GLB-001, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia or relapsed or refractory higher-risk myelodysplastic syndromes. It is given by mouth according to the assigned treatment schedule, and how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, and early signs of effect, and it aims to find the maximum tolerated dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa GLB-001, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda recidivante o refractaria, o con síndromes mielodisplásicos de alto riesgo recidivantes o refractarios. Se administra por vía oral según el esquema de tratamiento asignado; la duración y la frecuencia no están indicadas. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento y los primeros signos de efecto, y busca determinar la dosis máxima tolerada.
who_for: Age 18 years or older and able to sign the consent form
Confirmed acute myeloid leukemia, including secondary AML from MDS, or confirmed higher-risk MDS
Relapsed or refractory disease that failed or is not eligible for all available therapies that may help
White blood cell count below 25 x 10^9/L and adequate liver, kidney and clotting test values
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
not_for: Known leukemia involvement of the central nervous system
Active cancer other than AML or MDS
Known chronic active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or unable to swallow oral medicines
